note: Build-time provenance register for the content pipeline. One entry per upstream source. Raw downloads live OUTSIDE the repository in the cache dir (default ../.cache/raw, override with --cache or HANYU_CACHE); never copy them into the repo.

sources.upstreamProject: CC-CEDICT community maintenance project (CC-CEDICT.org), published by MDBG
sources.pinnedBy: release date in the file header (#! date=) plus the sha256 of the extracted cedict_ts.u8
sources.attribution: CC-CEDICT community maintenance project (CC-CEDICT.org) and contributors.
sources.attributionNote: Also credits CEDICT - Copyright (C) 1997, 1998 Paul Andrew Denisowski, as stated in the CC-CEDICT file header.

fetch.note: MDBG serves the dictionary as a zip; the cache stores the extracted member. The URL always points at the current release, so integrity is pinned by sha256.

transformations: Re-keyed into the canonical U+001F record schema (simplified, traditional, pinyinNumbered, pinyinMarked, pinyinPlain, definition).
Pinyin normalised to lowercase with single spaces; merged source syllables such as `bai3ke4` are split into `bai3 ke4`.
pinyinMarked and pinyinPlain precomputed locally by scripts/content/lib/pinyin.mjs (no upstream audio or third-party transliteration used).

Glosses joined with `; `; a leading `(also ...)`/`(variant of ...)` note is stripped only when the gloss still has content after it (8 of 125365 records in the pinned release), otherwise kept verbatim.
Sorted by simplified code-point order, then pinyinNumbered; sharded at 8192 records per file.
Header/comment lines and the `#!` metadata block are not carried into the pack.

sources.pinnedBy: version-numbered URL (immutable) plus sha256 of Unihan.zip
sources.attribution: Unicode (https://www.unicode.org) - Unicode™ and the Unicode logo are registered trademarks of Unicode, Inc. in the United States and other countries; Unihan data is used under the Unicode License v3.
sources.attributionNote: Unicode License v3 requires the copyright/permission notice to accompany the data or its documentation; the full text ships at public/licenses/Unicode-License-v3.txt.
transformations: Only the fields named by docs/DATA_FORMAT.md are read: kMandarin, kCantonese, kDefinition, kSimplifiedVariant, kTraditionalVariant, kRSUnicode, kTotalStrokes.
kRSUnicode is normalised to `<radicalNumber>'<restrokes>'` using the first value only (Unihan 16.0.0 stores the pair dot-separated, e.g. `1.0`).
kTotalStrokes uses the first value only.
Simplified/traditional variant lists are capped at 6 codepoints per record.
Codepoints are written as lowercase hex; records sorted by code point, 2048 per shard.

sources.upstreamProject: hanzi-writer-data (David Chanin), derived from the Make Me a Hanzi project (Alan Davis / skishore)
sources.pinnedBy: npm package version plus sha256 of the registry tarball
sources.licenseFileSource: hw/package/ARPHICPL.TXT copied verbatim (also available as hw/package/APL/english/ARPHICPL.TXT)
sources.attribution: Stroke outlines and medians from the Make Me a Hanzi project (https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi), distributed via hanzi-writer-data by David Chanin (https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data), licensed under the Arphic Public License (Copyright (C) 1999 Arphic Technology Co., Ltd.).
sources.shareAlikeNote: The Arphic Public License requires prominent change notices for modified data and keeps derived data under the same terms; change notices are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
transformations: One JSON object per character rewritten as compact JSONL, `{"c":char,"s":[outline paths],"m":[flattened medians]}`.
`radStrokes` from the upstream files is intentionally dropped (docs/DATA_FORMAT.md).
Median arrays are flattened from [[x,y],...] to [x0,y0,x1,y1,...]; the runtime re-pairs them.

SVG outline path strings are kept verbatim (integer coordinates in the 0..1024 write box; 49 of the 9,574 characters carry 55 upstream paths with .5 coordinates which are kept as-is rather than rounded, so the artwork is unchanged).
400 characters per shard, plus strokes/index.txt mapping each character to its shard.

sources.upstreamVersion: 2026-10-31 export snapshot (Last-Modified of the pinned files)
sources.pinnedBy: content hash: Tatoeba republishes the same URL, so each file is pinned by sha256
sources.attribution: Sentences and translations from the Tatoeba project (https://tatoeba.org), licensed CC BY 2.0 FR; original sentence ids and translations are preserved.
sources.attributionGap: The pinned per-language exports carry only `id`, `lang`, `text`. Contributor usernames are NOT present in them (they live in sentences_detailed/contributions dumps of 1.4 GB and 594 MB, deliberately not vendored). The <author> segment of every sourceRef is therefore the literal `unknown`; sentence ids are preserved so attribution can be resolved against tatoeba.org.
transformations: Mandarin sentences joined to their English translations through cmn-eng_links.tsv.bz2; only cmn->eng linked pairs are used.
Up to 3 sentences attached per CC-CEDICT headword of length >= 2 that occurs as a substring of the sentence.
Quality guard: sentences with fewer than 4 or more than 60 Hanzi characters are skipped.
Each sentence is converted to simplified and traditional with the Unihan kSimplifiedVariant/kTraditionalVariant maps; characters without a mapping are left unchanged (documented Unihan gap).
sourceRefs keep the form `tatoeba:<id>:<author>` joined by `+` (one item for the Chinese sentence, one for its English translation).
Sharded at 8192 records per file.
